scientific_integrity: The 2024 source introduced the invariant; the earlier general-position structure characterization and the extremal rook-product cardinality are credited. The claimed new result is the full two-sort star-forest enumerator, its recurrence, and leading multiplicities, supported by an infinite bijective proof and finite independent checks.
scientific_limitations: The scalar maximum is known and not claimed novel.
No assertion of real-rootedness, unimodality or asymptotic behavior.
An unindexed equivalent result phrased as star-forest species or forbidden length-three paths cannot be excluded.
Finite computational checks do not replace the all-parameter proof.
title: The general-position polynomial of rook graphs via labeled star forests
